claim.statement: On NEAR, the volume of transactions signed by function-call keys is a better leading indicator of real application usage than daily active accounts or token price.
claim.metric: fc_signed_tx: weekly share of sampled mainnet transactions signed by a function-call key (FUNCTION_CALL or DELEGATED_INNER_FC, classified at signing time) times the BigQuery census transaction count; log change week over week; one-step AR(2)+X forecast at its in-sample lag
claim.outcome: usdc_census: weekly USDC volume on NEAR, receiving side of successful NEP-141 ft_transfer events on native USDC 17208628...e36133a1 and USDC.e (BigQuery ft_events); log change
